tooltip.essentialcraft5.ancient_core.des.en: Dropped by the MRU Golem. Used to raise attunement stages.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.ancient_core.des.zh: 打倒聚能魔像掉的，装备同调升阶要用。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crystal.d.en: Dropped by the Matrix Specter. The more matrix damage the summoner poured into it, the more crystals the summoner gets. Used to raise attunement stages.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crystal.d.zh: 打倒矩阵之影掉的。召唤时转给它的矩阵损伤越多，召唤者拿到的越多。装备同调升阶要用。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crystal.d.en: Dropped by the Matrix Specter, one for everyone who gets a share. Used to raise attunement stages.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crystal.d.zh: 打倒矩阵之影掉的，分得到掉落的人每人 1 个。装备同调升阶要用。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.aberrant_residue.en: Left behind by the creatures native to Hoanna. Used to raise attunement stages.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.aberrant_residue.zh: 海纳尔本地的怪物身上掉的。装备同调升阶要用。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.aberrant_heart.d.en: Dropped by the elite creatures of Hoanna, and given out when you clear a nest. Used to raise attunement stages.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.aberrant_heart.d.zh: 海纳尔的精英怪掉的，清掉一处巢穴也能分到。装备同调升阶要用。
